executive_summary.root_cause_of_discrepancy: An accounting conflation in Milestone 12 pooled the 50 human-verified pairs of Dataset C (targeted M10 graph review queue) with the 1 human-verified pair of Dataset A (representative 500-pair sample in annotations_reviewer_1.csv), reporting '51 human-verified' under the representative benchmark summary. In reality, Dataset A contains exactly 1 human-verified pair, 49 purely AI-adopted diagnostic pairs (1 pair was both AI-adopted and human-reviewed), and 450 unannotated pending pairs. Dataset C contains 50 human-verified pairs with zero overlap with Dataset A.

zero_overlap_confirmation.confirmation: Dataset A and Dataset C are confirmed to have EXACTLY ZERO overlap.

ai_provenance_isolation.status: AI-adopted pilot labels are strictly tagged as AUTO_ADOPTED_AI and completely isolated from human gold standard.
